text:
Marta Sales: Passing 'Orion Spark' trial to CS. Tenant: orion-spark-trial. Renewal ~40d. No SSO. Shared signup notes: https://drive.redwood/orion-spark. Need owners for provisioning, a short walkthrough, and renewal monitoring. Any obvious risks?

Ravi CS: I'll own onboarding + renewal watch. Plan: 1) quick provisioning handoff 2) 10-min walkthrough recording 3) 20d check-in. Risk: medium because billing contact unknown and they asked about SSO timeline.

Sam Support: I'll handle provisioning. Opening ticket SUP-6033. Please drop org id and preferred region.

Marta Sales: Org id or-spk-77, region us-west-2. Demo dataset: sample_reviews.csv (shared).

Sam Support: Running provision script now:
```
POST /admin/provision
{ "tenant":"orion-spark-trial","org_id":"or-spk-77","env":"trial","region":"us-west-2" }
```
Will report back.

Nora Eng: FYI if they do >2rps bursts, set trial model to redwood/gpt-lite-quant and min autoscale to 0.4 GPU-equivalent. I'll watch for latency.

Ravi CS: expected peak ~1.8 rps, avg 0.2 rps, flows <=150 tokens. Sounds good.

Sam Support: Provision complete. Endpoint: https://orion-spark-trial.api.redwood/v1. API key masked. Smoke tests passed. Ticket SUP-6033 updated and closing unless issues arise.

Nora Eng: Pushed autoscale tweak and added a simple latency dashboard. Patch INF-ORSPK-01.

Ravi CS: I'll record the 10-min walkthrough and capture customer asks (demo, clearer prompts, SSO ETA) into C360 after kickoff.

Marta Sales: Scheduling kickoff Wed 2025-03-19 09:30 PT, inviting CS + Support + their PM.

SchedBot: Calendar event created for 2025-03-19T09:30:00-07:00.

Ravi CS: Owners recap:
- Sam: provisioning & support triage (SUP-6033) - done
- Nora: autoscale + dashboard - done
- Ravi: walkthrough + 20d check-in + renewal watch
- Marta: billing contact + kickoff invite

Marta Sales: Marking renewal risk = monitor. Will escalate if finance flags SSO before renewal.

Ravi CS: Noted. Closing pass to CS.
